title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-9 Pre-Departure News Conference – Tuesday, March 4, 2025
description: Aboard the International Space Station NASA astronauts Nick Hague, Suni Williams, and Butch Wilmore gave remarks about their mission during a news conference March 4. The Crew-9 astronauts will return to Earth via a parachute assisted splashdown later this month. The four crew members have been living and working aboard the microgravity laboratory to advance scientific knowledge and demonstrate new technologies for future human and robotic exploration flights as part of NASA’s Moon and Mars exploration approach, including lunar missions through NASA’s Artemis program.    Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
keywords: Expedition 72, SpaceX Crew-9 Pre-Departure News Conference
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
